Regions

Each region of the map covers one area of computer science. Begin with Computational Thinking; every road leads to Ethics and Impacts.

Start here Coming soon

Computational Thinking

The starting point. Students learn to break problems into parts, recognize patterns, focus on what matters, and describe solutions as clear steps.

Coming soon

Algorithms and Coding

Students design, write, test, and debug programs on paper, then run them by hand, from first sequences and loops to complete projects.

In progress

Data Science

Students ask questions, collect and clean data, look for patterns, build simple models, and communicate what the data shows.

Coming soon

AI Literacy

Students learn how AI systems learn from examples, where they succeed and fail, and how to evaluate what they produce.

Coming soon

Cybersecurity

Students learn how systems and information are attacked and defended, from passwords and phishing to encryption.

Coming soon

Ethics and Impacts

At the center of the map, where every road meets. Students examine how computing affects individuals, communities, and society.
